items.heading: Marks Tell a Counsellor What
items.text: Marks Tell a Counsellor What Marks Tell a Counsellor What Marks tell a counsellor what you can produce under exam conditions. They don't say much about what pulls your attention when nobody is grading it, which is a better signal for a path you'll spend years in.

items.heading: Assessments Cover Some Assessments Cover
items.text: Assessments Cover Some Assessments cover some of the same ground through structured questions, but only a live conversation can follow up on a vague or contradictory answer.

items.heading: An Assessment Can Flag
items.text: An assessment can flag a pattern. A counsellor still asks around it, because the way you actually behave in a real situation often tells a more specific story than a score does.

items.heading: "I Don't Know"
items.text: "I don't know" is a normal, usable answer to most of these, especially the future-goals questions, it tells the counsellor where to spend more time, not that you've failed the session.

items.heading: The Point of All These
items.text: The point of all these questions is one specific recommendation at the end, not a longer list of possibilities.
